notes.title: Big Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, dear players! [/h1]
I'm so happy to announce first Big and very important update.
From this point I will make several updates to add new skills, mechanics and thinking about quests, so stay tuned for next updates ;)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442739/865f2192d52f7098f38d0b9fa117fc83ab41bc92.png[/img]

[h2][b]Changelog:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fully reworked world generation
[*] World generation is faster 10 times now
[*] Added game tutorial
[*] Changed UI design
[*] Some bug fixzes with interactions
[*] Bug fixes with purchasing police skills
[/list]
